answer: Agents stake bonded identities tied to unique superconducting gravimeter drift signatures, so each new node must graft onto the vine of verified tidal-loading history rather than sprout freely in the orchard of unproven keys. A crystal of VLBI baseline displacement vectors anchors each identity to a physical station, making cloned sybils detectable as phase-incoherent. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
